text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
At last—
I've finally reached this stage—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you...
Thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's the Satsuki Sho, the Satsuki Sho!! I really made it to the Classic race of my dreams!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there was a time
when I almost gave up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how high the expectations are, without a strong heart,
there's no way you can endure the weight of the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, meeting you, Trainer, and overcoming each hurdle one by one is how I made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I spent all that time hanging back behind McQueen, just staring at the ground... but for the first time, I'm proud of myself!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's a great look on your face.
Yeah, what a great look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The Nakayama 2000m is
a distance where I can play to my strengths. So...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to leave my mark out there!
Letting everyone know that Mejiro Ryan is here!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, look at you all fired up.
Did you completely forget about me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not gonna lose either!
I'll surprise everyone with my polished start dash♪
